interpretation.what_is_known: The same endpoint accepted the strict starting-role schema, but rejected the larger paired current-plus-qualification schema before returning model output.
interpretation.what_is_not_known: The provider error does not identify the exact unsupported schema feature, so this call alone cannot distinguish size, nesting, or a specific schema keyword.
interpretation.catalog_caveat: Endpoint-level structured-output support is necessary but not sufficient evidence that every valid JSON Schema shape is accepted.

decision.next_provider_free_design: Reuse the already proven single-role v2.3 schema to give current and qualification separate strict tasks. Deterministic code may validate and join only explicit role labels and evidence identifiers; it must not infer role meaning or repair prose.
decision.why: This tests the task-decomposition hypothesis directly and changes semantic workload size instead of adding brittle deterministic gates.
